Title: Room card shows image for every room type
Expected Result: Every card displays a loaded room photo with meaningful alt text; no empty grey block.

Title: Heading count equals number of distinct room types shown

Title: Price slider filters list and updates count
Expected Result: Only rooms within range listed; heading count updates; Clear filters restores all rooms.

Title: Homepage sections display their content
